definitions.explanation: The outer walls of a building that protect the interior from weather and provide structural support.

examples.japanese: {外壁|がいへき}の{塗装|とそう}が{剥|は}げてきた。
examples.english: The paint on the exterior wall has started to peel.

examples.japanese: {外壁|がいへき}{工事|こうじ}のため{足場|あしば}が{組|く}まれている。
examples.english: Scaffolding has been set up for the exterior wall work.

examples.japanese: {外壁|がいへき}に{断熱|だんねつ}{材|ざい}を{入|い}れる。
examples.english: To install insulation in the exterior wall.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {外|がい} (outside) + {壁|へき} (wall). Literally "outside wall."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{外壁|がいへき}{塗装|とそう} (exterior wall painting)
・{外壁|がいへき}{工事|こうじ} (exterior wall construction/repair)
・{外壁|がいへき}リフォーム (exterior wall renovation)
・{外壁|がいへき}{材|ざい} (exterior wall material)
・{外壁|がいへき}の{亀裂|きれつ}/{ひび} (cracks in the exterior wall)

COMMON MATERIALS:
・サイディング (siding)
・モルタル (mortar)
・タイル (tile)
・コンクリート (concrete)

RELATED TERMS:
・{内壁|ないへき} (interior wall)
・{内装|ないそう} (interior decoration)
・{断熱|だんねつ} (insulation)
・{防水|ぼうすい} (waterproofing)
・{外装|がいそう} (exterior - broader term including walls and facade)
